candidate_contract.hypothesis: Two admitted reusable source leases can overlap exact selected-observation fill and ordered consumption, reducing total wall time without changing scientific results or growing residency with MeasurementSet size.
candidate_contract.predicted_terminal_effect: The candidate is faster than this control on the same medium command and on the directly mounted 32 GiB workload, while the full 106.9 GiB gate remains bounded and shows useful producer-consumer overlap.
automatic_falsifiers: scientific products exceed the pinned CASA thresholds or differ from the accepted serial Rust result
the medium or directly mounted 32 GiB candidate is not faster than its matched control
the candidate adds a hidden MeasurementSet pass, implicit copy, unplanned allocation, unbounded queue, full grid per worker, fallback, or alternate MFS path
the full 106.9 GiB gate does not complete with stable bounded residency and useful two-lease overlap
candidate_contract.wall_limit: 30 minutes for turnaround or medium work; runs projected beyond 90 minutes are final evidence only
candidate_contract.retention: retain compact JSON receipts and product-comparison results; external image products are generated evidence
